scope: Exact frozen candidate01; test-only native F13 original-Document snapshot and F14 sole pending-latch release. Source review only. Root alone applies and runs. No runtime, full125/17, product launch or merge acceptance.

sdk_source_evidence.fact: exposeBinding awaits binding init-script registration and existing-main-world evaluation before returning.
allInitScripts orders global binding controller, registered binding init scripts, then context/page init scripts; Chromium replay uses this list.
Chromium registers each ordered allInitScripts script for main-world new Documents.
PageBinding.dispatch parses serialized arguments and calls playwrightFunction before callback result evaluateExpressionHandle; browser reply is fire-and-forget with rejection caught.
Runtime.bindingCalled selects the actual execution context for incoming callback; Node callback exposes its page/frame.

findings.problem: On native-send rejection or local deadline, finally clears inputWaiter without rejecting its pending reply promise. remove can no longer settle that reply, leaving Promise.all reply ownership unfinished.
findings.requested_change: Reject any still-pending waiter with a fixed non-sensitive error before clearing it; do not await/retry or extend the existing clock.

findings.problem: New exposeBinding or probe addInitScript can reject before cacheVariant enters its owned try/finally. Owned page and partially installed console listener bypass cleanup.
findings.requested_change: Install probe inside existing cacheVariant try with optional catch observation/removal. Ensure installProbe removes its console listener when addInitScript rejects before it returns, while preserving the original rejection. Keep root-owned page-close independent.

limits: Source ordering proves installed registration path, not successful runtime binding restoration. Actual original-Document trusted callback must be witnessed in root consumer.
SDK may drop binding dispatch if original execution context is unavailable; no replacement context, synthesized event or fallback is accepted.
Pending native protocol commands are not claimed canceled at local deadline; owned page closure must retire them.
Node receipt order is not independently dated browser/BFF occurrence order. Earlier15s abort cause remains unknown.
Native-input mechanism is an authorized test instrument in an isolated owned browser; this review does not treat it as production identity attestation.
Prior RED runs remain RED. Source repair cannot fill required final125 native and17 browser terminal evidence.
